hook_line: TRUMP CITES INDIA'S 7% GROWTH TO ATTACK THE FED

hook_stat.sub: The growth figure for India that Trump cited at the White House on Friday

stats.label: Official US third-quarter GDP growth at an annual rate
Debt costs per percentage point of interest rates, as cited by Trump
US PCE inflation in September, above the Fed's 2 per cent target

diaspora_bullets: No rate change was announced — the remarks are presidential pressure on the Fed, not a policy decision
Borrowing costs move only when the Fed itself acts, so US mortgage and credit-card rates are unchanged
news_summary: US President Donald Trump on Friday cited India's low interest rates and 7 per cent GDP growth to attack the Federal Reserve, calling it very political and arguing US growth could reach 15 to 20 per cent if rates were lower.
payoff: Nothing in Friday's remarks changes policy: the Fed sets rates independently, and no rate change was announced.
